relationships.subject: MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: Excessive activity of MMP-9 in the acute phase of SCI disrupts the BSCB, edema, excitotoxicity, infiltration of leukocytes, mitochondrial dysfunction, apoptosis, demyelination of neurons, increase in inflammatory responses and astrogliosis

relationships.subject: SB-3CT
relationships.evidence_quote: treatment with SB-3CT, a gelatinase inhibitor, at 2 hours before SCI, reduced MMP-9 activity and BSCB disruption, ultimately decreasing apoptosis

relationships.subject: AZD1236
relationships.evidence_quote: AZD1236 is a potent and reversible inhibitor of MMP-9 and MMP-12, with an IC50 of 4.5 and 6.1 nM, respectively.
